title: exam_mode
description: Exam mode for the device's lab (servers that list `exam_mode` in `server_info.features`). `enabled: true` turns it on or replaces the running configuration: block all traffic except the POps server, DNS, DHCP and `allow`, show `message` in the tray, block the programs in `block_apps`, and leave exam mode at `until` even when offline. Agents from 0.1.24 count the time left (`until - now`) on a monotonic clock, so a PC clock that is ahead or behind does not shorten or lengthen the exam. Sent when an admin starts an exam (POST /api/labs/{lab}/exam), after every connection of a device whose lab has a running exam (after queued commands), when a connected device is moved into such a lab, and again when the agent reports an `until` that differs from the exam's. `enabled: false` (no other field) ends it: sent when the exam ends (admin or `until`), when the device is moved out of the lab, on connect when an exam the device may still apply ended early, and when the agent reports `enabled: true` while its lab has no exam (at most once a minute). The agent answers with `exam_state`; with the `exam` capability switched off locally it answers `capability_denied` (`capability: exam`, `action: exam_mode`).

enabled.description: true: start or replace exam mode; false: end it (the other fields are then absent).

allow.description: Reachable besides the POps server, DNS and DHCP: lower-case domain names (punycode for non-ASCII; no wildcards; resolve them regularly), IPv4/IPv6 addresses and CIDR networks (`10.1.0.0/24`). May be empty (only the server, DNS and DHCP).

until.description: End as unix seconds, on the server's clock. `null` would mean no end time; this server always sends a number at most 8 hours ahead, and agents from 0.1.24 never keep exam mode longer than 8 hours.

now.description: The server's time in unix seconds when it sent the message (from 0.1.24). The agent takes `until - now` as the time left and counts it down on a monotonic clock; it keeps at most 8 hours. Without `now` (older servers) the agent compares `until` with its own clock.

message.description: Tray banner text, at most 200 characters (the server fills in a default when the admin left it empty).

block_apps.description: Lower-case program file names (`cmd.exe`) to block while exam mode runs; may be empty. The server never lists the agent's own processes or Windows session processes.
